title: Wasmtime linear memory boundary escape via 32-bit pointer integer overflow
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0902: Wasmtime linear memory boundary escape via 32-bit pointer integer overflow
Repository: `bytecodealliance/wasmtime`
Category: `Security Sandbox & Serialization Exploits`
Target File: `crates/environ/src/memory.rs`

#### Problem Description
Offset addition in memory.grow instruction wraps around 4GB boundary, allowing out-of-bounds heap read.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Validate 64-bit extended pointer bounds check before issuing WebAssembly load/store.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0902.py -q`
expected_invariant: Validate 64-bit extended pointer bounds check before issuing WebAssembly load/store.
